notes: Craft: five scenes on a near-black field with the glass as the only saturated body — the spectrum scene uses a six-colour palette strictly as presentation. No historical window reconstructed; no NASA/analogous asset question arises. E0 acceptance repair: title/field collision fixed on m-gla-0-aperture, m-gla-2-seams, m-gla-5-return (title width 560; formations iteratively scaled and dropped clear of the title band); cover re-captured.

#0 aperture — the light ☀ approaches and enters the made square (position + size); B/p → p→B stages the record's own asymmetry (order of being vs order of recognition); attract/pulse — the light drawn through; no automation (the entry is single).

#1 spectrum — ring layout: the white disc cycles its tint through red, teal, slate — plenitude carrying differentiated colour (QL), never losing one field; ∅# → QL names the harmonic order; attract/implode — the gathering into spectrum; auto-spectrum LFO on circulation (the light's breathing).

#2 seams — grid layout (the lead lattice); ≠ → / at the window's foot: the mere-placement refused becomes the seam — the join that divides-and-holds; the lead ring breathes (holding while marking); repel/shove — obstruction retained; the apparatus/light correction (lead→apparatus, QL→light, MEF within the order, never a certifying superior) carried by e544's name and the binding guard.

#3 projection — the changing cast: e545's tint cycles warm→dark→teal with size shifts (sun, pane, room, viewer changing); 180°→360° the contextual turn; vortex/pulse — the viewer moving among positions; auto-projection LFO on dispersion (the shifting cast).

#5→0 return — THE 3D SCENE. z is the return's direction: the window approached again deepest (z −0.4, brightening), ¶ Dyczkowski's limits at z 0, ◉◉ Bohm at z +0.2, and the declared returns nearest (M05 → C38 at z +0.35 — the declared movements focusing into the local-Bimba office); pointer attract/pulse firmer — recognition returning to the aperture; auto-return LFO on pointerStrength.

ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 began with ☀ outside the aperture and the order-stamp B/p (being first); #5→0 returns the viewer to that window — now deepest in the scene, approached, its determinacy brightening — with the recognition-order (p→B) vindicated: the declared returns (M05→C38) sit nearest because the return is where the construction lives; the seams of #2 remain (¶ at z 0 holds Dyczkowski's limits; ◉◉ holds Bohm as resonance, not extraction), so the ending re-reads the aperture without possessing it. The Original remains prior throughout.

Human-amplified guards carried (relation-local): no historical window or sacred programme reconstructed; the sun supplies no warrant for a metaphysical source outside Consciousness; no additional symbolism assigned to particular colours or panes; the attractor/atlas distinction kept (an attractor organising trajectories is not an atlas of charts); Gebser used through page-specific paraphrase; notebook passages not promoted to edition-verified quotations. Mythemic verbs only: the window demonstrates transmission-with-obstruction; the seams retain provenance.

Automation: auto-spectrum (the light's breathing), auto-projection (the shifting cast), auto-return (recognition answerable) — tied to the record's moves; #0 and #2 held without automation (the entry and the seam are still). Durations 12–15, transitions 1.3–2.0; the return held longest.

glyph_rationales.the originating light — the sun outside: The sun — the originating light whose priority the room's image does not exhaust.
glyph_rationales.the rose window — panes and lead as a ma: The rose window — a made aperture: coloured panes given determinate passages, the lead holding their boundaries.
glyph_rationales.the light shaft — determinate transmissi: The light shaft — transmission across the interior; the visible colour carries relations the colour alone cannot display completely.
glyph_rationales.the cast image — pratibimba in the room: The cast image — pratibimba: the determinate display encountered first, its Original prior in being.
glyph_rationales.the viewer — the one who encounters the: The viewer — encounters the image first and follows its differences back toward what made them possible.
glyph_rationales.Bimba / pratibimba — the Original prior: B/p — Bimba names the Original order, pratibimba its determinate display; prior in being, later in recognition.
glyph_rationales.the white light — apparent unity holding: The white light — plenitude: apparent unity holding the possibility of differentiated colour together with the relations through which the colours belong to one field.
glyph_rationales.the pane's office — a difference given a: The prism — the pane's office: giving a difference a passage, not first creating the capacity for difference in a contentless source.
glyph_rationales.a local colour — one of the sixfold body: A local colour — one pane's optical difference, a member of the sixfold body; no pane receives a permanent number, tradition or colour by decree.
glyph_rationales.the pane grid — transmission and obstruc: The pane grid — each pane with material, density, colour and angle: placement permits transmission, bends or colours what passes, leaves something obstructed.
glyph_rationales.the lead cames — neighbours held in rela: The lead cames — holding neighbouring panes in relation while marking where one passage ends and another begins; provenance, discontinuity, translation limits, contradiction, changes of register.
glyph_rationales.the opaque mosaic — fragments arranged i: The opaque mosaic — the quilt's contrast: arrangement without transmission, which is what the window refuses to be.
glyph_rationales.the bent passage — colour with change, n: The bent passage — the medium changes what passes; removing every difference would also remove the particular transformations through which the composition becomes articulate.
glyph_rationales.the refractive apparatus — media, angles: MEF — the meta-epistemic operation of refraction: a lens changes a question, inference or judgment while keeping its conditions inspectable; not an authority exterior to the light.
glyph_rationales.the changed sun — the display changes wi: The changed sun — as sun, pane, angle, room and viewer change, the projected colour changes.
glyph_rationales.the window — the constructed opening, he: The window — the constructed opening held together with the appearance it makes possible; looking only at the glass or only at the image misses the event.
glyph_rationales.the changing projection — a region previ: The changing projection — a later display makes visible a region the earlier arrangement withheld; the order across the transformations belongs to Bimba/QL, the appearances remain pratibimbas.
glyph_rationales.the invested viewer — body, position, at: The invested viewer — body, position, attention and concern enter what is seen and what becomes significant; seeing through includes being with what is seen.
glyph_rationales.the contextual turn — one field, more th: The contextual turn — positions cease to claim isolated completeness as joint conditions become available: 180° opening into 360°, the field which permits more than one perspective.
glyph_rationales.the atlas complement — a chart-transitio: The atlas complement — charts specifying local domains and transitions on overlaps; each whole retains the operation the other cannot perform.
glyph_rationales.the rose window, returned to — determina: The returned window — what first appeared a self-contained pattern now discloses the source, selected passages and boundaries of its appearing.
glyph_rationales.the enfolding ring — implicate and expli: The enfolding ring — Bohm's implicated wholeness and differentiated display, held resonant-with, not extraction; no optical proof.
glyph_rationales.the returned viewer — a seam examined, a: The returned viewer — a seam examined, a source reread, a translation qualified, a lens repositioned, an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment.
glyph_rationales.the lattice window — light appearing div: The lattice window — Dyczkowski's p.65 image: light appearing diverse through limiting conditions.
glyph_rationales.the inert mirror — displays without know: The inert mirror — pp.69–70: an inert mirror or crystal can display without knowing; the analogy loses the external object ordinary reflection requires.
glyph_rationales.the return — recognition comes back thro: The return — recognition returns to the aperture; within a declared frame the achieved map serves as local Bimba while remaining pratibimba to wider sources.
glyph_rationales.B/p: Bimba/pratibimba — the Original order and its determinate display; what is prior in being is later in recognition.
glyph_rationales.MEF: MEF — the meta-epistemic framework: declared media, angles, transformations, exclusions; conditions kept inspectable.
glyph_rationales.↺: The return sign — recognition returns to the aperture; the Original remains prior throughout.
